---
title: "Reference manual"
---

This page is the complete documentation of SigDoTS: every function, what it does, and every
argument with its meaning, its allowed values and its default, followed by what the function
returns and an example. It is the same text as the help pages in R (`?sigdots`,
`?sigdots_control`, ...), gathered on one page in the order in which you would use the
functions. The same manual as a PDF: [SigDoTS-manual.pdf](../SigDoTS-manual.pdf).

```{r manual, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Every help page of the installed package, rendered by R's own converter (tools::Rd2HTML), so
# the text is exactly that of ?topic in R. The function's name is put before each title, and
# R's section headings are moved one level down so that the table of contents on the right
# lists the functions. Every "$" is written as the HTML code for "$": pandoc reads this HTML
# as Markdown, and two "$" in one paragraph, as in domains(fit)$spot[domains(fit)$domain == k],
# became a formula with the dollar signs removed (found on the GitHub-built site, 2026-11-02).
topics <- c("SigDoTS-package" = "The SigDoTS package", sigdots = "sigdots()",
            sigdots_control = "sigdots_control()", sigdots_prepare = "sigdots_prepare()",
            summary.sigdots = "print() and summary()", domains = "domains()",
            add_domains = "add_domains()", plot.sigdots = "plot()",
            sigdots_example = "sigdots_example")
db <- tools::Rd_db("SigDoTS")
tmp <- tempfile("manual")
dir.create(file.path(tmp, "html"), recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(tmp, "help"))   # Rd2HTML writes small redirect files here
version <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("SigDoTS"))
cat("<div class=\"ref-manual\">\n")
for (nm in names(topics)) {
  f <- file.path(tmp, "html", paste0(nm, ".html"))
  invisible(utils::capture.output(suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
    tools::Rd2HTML(db[[paste0(nm, ".Rd")]], out = f, package = c("SigDoTS", version),
                   standalone = FALSE, no_links = TRUE)))))
  h <- paste(readLines(f, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
  prefix <- if (nm == "SigDoTS-package") "" else sprintf("<code>%s</code>: ", topics[[nm]])
  h <- sub("<h2 id='[^']*'>", sprintf("<h2 id='%s'>%s", gsub(".", "-", nm, fixed = TRUE), prefix), h)
  h <- gsub("<(/?)h3>", "<\\1h4>", h)
  h <- gsub("$", "&#36;", h, fixed = TRUE)
  cat(h, "\n\n")
}
cat("</div>\n")
```
